$comment: Review allow-list for migration directories that may exist in a deployable
tree. This file does not authorize production migration execution.
assertReviewedMigrations blocks any migration directory present in the
release that is not listed here, and any entry listed here that is not
present in the release. Adding a migration therefore BLOCKS deployment
until a human adds it to this file, which is the review point.
Each entry must be reviewed for: generated SQL, backward compatibility with
the currently deployed application (expand/contract), constraints and
financial integrity, idempotency, data preservation, append-only ledger
behavior, locking, failure/rollback limitations, and a rehearsed backup and
recovery procedure. See docs/adr/0006-tenancy-core-schema.md.
Ordinary PR and main CI use disposable databases only and never apply
production migrations. Production migrations execute only inside the
protected production deployment workflow after all authorization gates
pass: exact SHA and main-push CI, workflow_dispatch with
authorize_production=true, protected environment review, this allow-list,
explicit migration approval, and verified backup and recovery evidence.
infrastructure/scripts/deploy.mjs invokes `prisma migrate deploy` inside
that workflow before PM2 activation; a migration failure prevents
application activation. Do not run a manual migrate command against
production. Code rollback does not reverse SQL; database restoration
requires separate explicit approval and never restores into live production
without it. Listing a migration here permits the CODE to deploy; it does
not apply the migration or authorize its execution.
